label: Root-zone soil moisture 0-100 cm (SMAP L4) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
colormap: Red-white-green 7 bins (red = lowest / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = highest / increase)
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: SMAP SPL4SMGP v008 via NASA AppEEARS
basis: wet-season mean (Jun-Sep) of the monthly values, so dry-season zeros do not flatten the slope. Missing months are filled by the climatology-anomaly method (yearly = mean monthly climatology + mean anomaly of the observed months); a year needs >= half of the season observed unless stated otherwise.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in m³/m³ per yr. brown = drier / less water, teal = wetter / more water; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
